title: Interior Painting Cork | Walls, Ceilings and Woodwork
description: Interior painting in Cork city and county. Walls, ceilings, doors, skirting and stairs. Filling and sanding included, floors covered, two coats as standard.

faq.q: How long does a room take?
faq.a: A standard bedroom or sitting room, walls and ceiling, is usually one to two days including prep and drying time between coats. Woodwork adds time. We give you a day count with the written price.

faq.q: Do we need to move the furniture?
faq.a: Move what you can, especially small and breakable things. Large pieces can stay. We move them to the middle of the room and cover them, then put them back when we finish.

faq.q: Is paint included in the price?
faq.a: Either way. We can supply the paint and show it as its own line on the quote, or you buy it and we paint with it. Say which you prefer when you ask for a quote.

faq.q: Can you match an existing colour?
faq.a: Usually, yes. If you have the tin or the colour name we use that. If not, a small sample from an area that will not be seen can be matched at a paint supplier.
Ask when you request a quote and we will tell you what is possible for your dates.

title: Exterior Painting Cork | Masonry, Render and Woodwork
description: Exterior painting in Cork city and county. Masonry, render, fascia, soffit, doors and windows. Surfaces washed and prepared first, two coats as standard.

faq.q: How long does the outside of a house take?
faq.a: A typical semi-detached house is usually two to four days of painting, depending on the size, the condition of the walls and the weather. We give you a day count with the written price.
Masonry paint needs dry surfaces and a dry spell to cure. If rain comes in we stop and come back. Exterior dates are always subject to weather and we keep you posted.

faq.q: Is paint included in the price?
faq.a: Either way. We can supply the masonry and trim paint and show it as its own line on the quote, or you buy it and we paint with it.

faq.q: Can you match the existing colour?
faq.a: Usually, yes. If you know the colour name or have the tin we use that. If not, a paint supplier can match a sample. Weathered paint fades, so a full repaint in the matched colour will look fresher than the old finish.
Ask when you request a quote and we will tell you what is possible for your dates.

title: Wallpapering Cork | Hanging, Stripping and Lining
description: Wallpapering in Cork city and county. Feature walls and full rooms, old paper stripped, walls lined where needed, patterns matched, edges clean.

faq.q: How long does a feature wall take?
faq.a: A single feature wall is usually a day, including prep. A full room is longer, and stripping old paper adds time. We give you a day count with the written price.

faq.q: Do we need to move the furniture?
faq.a: Clear the wall being papered if you can. Anything else can stay and we cover it.

You choose and buy the paper so you get exactly what you want. Tell us the roll width, pattern repeat and the wall size and we will say how many rolls to order. Paste and lining paper we can supply and show on the quote.

faq.q: Can you paper over old wallpaper?
faq.a: We do not recommend it. Old paper is stripped, the wall is washed and filled, and lining paper goes on where the wall needs it. That is what gives a flat finish that stays up.
Ask when you request a quote and we will tell you what is possible for your dates.
